text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Employment (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2009 and shall come into operation on 27th July 2009.

2. The following offences may be compounded by the Commissioner in accordance with section 114 of the Act:
(a)any offence (other than a continuing offence) under section 14(7), 19, 34(1), 48(4), 53(1), 61, 66(7), 71(2), 74, 82, 84(6), 87, 87A(7) or (7A), 90(1), 101(1), 107, 108, 110, 111, 124(2) or 126D(2) of the Act;
[S 146/2016 wef 01/04/2016]
(b)any offence under regulation 12 of the Employment (Part‑Time Employees) Regulations (Rg 8);
[S 141/2017 wef 01/04/2017]
(c)any offence under regulation 4 of the Employment (Female Workmen) Regulations (Rg 7).
[S 245/2014 wef 01/04/2014]
